dominant_breach: climate residual-market insurance is becoming a public/private backstop for home-equity preservation without clear incidence of assessments, rate shock, or nonrenewal burden
fastest_washout: premiums, deductibles, assessments, and repair gaps turn nominal home equity into a self-eroding foothold

public_balance_sheet_gate.note: Residual-market and flood-insurance systems now require explicit contingent-liability and mortgage-stress treatment: federal audits and Fed research show affordability/availability, mortgage delinquency, and mitigation/fiscal-exposure channels; this remains a public-backstop perimeter, not certification.

climate_residual_insurance_backstop.note: Rev0367 binds homeowners-insurance affordability/availability, NFIP fiscal exposure, NFIP debt/borrowing authority, reinsurance limits, Citizens currentness, and FAIR Plan governance into a locator-bound but noncertifying residual-insurance backstop perimeter.

insurer_of_last_resort_assessment_incide.note: Assessment incidence now requires state-specific proof: Citizens reports lower policy count and lower rates, while California FAIR Plan governance/exposure surfaces remain live. Neither by itself proves who bears post-event losses.

contingent_liability_disclosure.note: The case now demands separate disclosure for NFIP Treasury debt/borrowing authority, reinsurance attachment, residual-plan exposure, assessments/surcharges, mitigation timing, and public disaster-aid layering.

generational_incidence.note: Future buyers, renters, local governments, lower-credit-score households, and mortgage guarantors can inherit rising premium, nonrenewal, mitigation, and default burdens; rev0367 binds this as a stress channel but not final incidence.

proof_debt: state-by-state residual-market exposure, policy-count, assessment authority, and reinsurance/claim-paying resources by peril
NFIP debt, borrowing authority, reinsurance attachment, mitigation backlog, affordability shortfall, and repetitive-loss-property incidence
premium, deductible, nonrenewal, coverage-quality, underinsurance, and lender-required coverage incidence by income, race, age, tenure, credit score, and hazard zone
mortgage delinquency/default, GSE/FHA/VA/private mortgage-credit loss, home-value, local-tax-base, and renter pass-through channels after insurance shock
public-upside and loss-recovery terms: mitigation conditions, risk-based fees, assessment recoupment limits, clawbacks, building-code/land-use conditions, public seniority, and sunset/review rules

gate_20_public_balance_sheet.why: Comfort certification is blocked until residual-market exposure, NFIP debt/borrowing authority, reinsurance attachment, assessment incidence, coverage gaps, mortgage delinquency/default interaction, post-event liquidity, and public-upside or mitigation recovery terms are disclosed and stress-tested.

evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Refresh California FAIR Plan, Citizens, and other FAIR/residual-market exposure/policy-count/assessment data with current official releases.

evidence_debt_register.question: NFIP fiscal exposure and debt waterfall
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Bind NFIP debt, borrowing authority, reinsurance attachment/exhaustion, Risk Rating 2.0 affordability effects, repetitive-loss properties, and mitigation backlog.

evidence_debt_register.question: assessment and post-event financing incidence
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Map statutory assessment authority, insurer recoupment, surcharges, bonds, guaranty funds, reinsurance, NFIP borrowing, and public liquidity by claimant.

evidence_debt_register.question: coverage withdrawal, underinsurance, and household equity loss
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Connect nonrenewal, premium, deductible, lender requirement, disaster-aid timing, and property-value impairment data.

evidence_debt_register.question: public-upside and mitigation recovery terms
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Find actual public recovery/mitigation terms: fees, clawbacks, cost shares, land-use/building-code requirements, relocation/buyout conditions, or public seniority after public support.

20A_debt_interest_capacity.question: Do debt service and maturity/interest risks crowd out floors, services, enforcement, public investment, or countercyclical repair?
20A_debt_interest_capacity.finding: This subgate is not a material live channel in this case.

20B_claim_security.question: Are social-insurance, pension, health, disability, care, or public-benefit promises financed and legally durable enough to count as wealth substitutes?
20B_claim_security.finding: This subgate is not a material live channel in this case.

20C_contingent_liabilities_guarantees.question: Are guarantees, insurance funds, credit programs, SOEs, PPPs, disaster obligations, and legal claims disclosed and stress-tested?
20C_contingent_liabilities_guarantees.finding: Residual insurance and NFIP exposures require separate disclosure of plan exposure, debt, borrowing authority, reinsurance, assessments, and disaster-aid backfill.

20D_crisis_backstop_governance.question: Who is rescued under stress, under what terms, with what haircut, condition, sunset, and report?
20D_crisis_backstop_governance.finding: Post-disaster claims payment, NFIP borrowing, residual-plan assessments, and reinsurance attachment need stress governance before any pass verdict.

20E_public_upside_recovery.question: Does the public receive warrants, equity, fees, clawbacks, senior claims, recoveries, or other upside when it absorbs downside?
20E_public_upside_recovery.finding: If public systems absorb downside through subsidized premiums, borrowing, mitigation grants, disaster aid, or post-event liquidity, mitigation conditions, risk-based fees, recoupment, or other recovery terms must be explicit.

20F_central_bank_quasi_fiscal_visibility.question: Are remittance losses, deferred assets, interest-on-reserves distribution, facilities, and asset-price stabilization effects visible?
20F_central_bank_quasi_fiscal_visibility.finding: This subgate is not a material live channel in this case.

20G_public_asset_sovereign_wealth_govern.question: Are public assets rule-bound, professionally managed, protected from raiding, and linked to ordinary claimants?
20G_public_asset_sovereign_wealth_govern.finding: This subgate is not a material live channel in this case.

20H_generational_intergovernmental_incid.question: Does repair fall on younger cohorts, renters, disabled claimants, caregivers, migrants, municipalities, or future taxpayers?
20H_generational_intergovernmental_incid.finding: Higher premiums, mortgage delinquency, mitigation gaps, and repetitive-loss fiscal exposure can move costs to younger buyers, renters, local tax bases, and future federal/state taxpayers.

public_balance_sheet_register.legal_authority: State-created residual-market insurance plans and insurer-assessment rules
public_balance_sheet_register.claimant_perimeter: Homeowners, renters, mortgage lenders/servicers, insurers, residual-market policyholders, nonrenewed households, state backstop entities, taxpayers, local governments, and future buyers in hazard zones.
public_balance_sheet_register.maximum_exposure: State residual-plan published exposure/policies plus NFIP borrowing/debt capacity; stress maximum depends on event severity, reinsurance attachment/exhaustion, assessment authority, public disaster aid, and mortgage-default propagation.
public_balance_sheet_register.expected_loss: Unknown without event-specific loss model, NFIP actuarial/affordability shortfall, reinsurance attachment, state assessment statute, and coverage/underinsurance distribution.
public_balance_sheet_register.stress_scenario: A climate disaster or market withdrawal pushes households into residual coverage or underinsurance; post-event claims, assessments, surcharges, rate increases, nonrenewals, and disaster aid determine whose home equity survives.
public_balance_sheet_register.funding_source: premiums, reinsurance, insurer assessments, possible public disaster aid or financing
public_balance_sheet_register.loss_sharing: Define statutory assessment order, insurer recoupment limits, policyholder/renter pass-through, NFIP Treasury borrowing, reinsurance attachment, mitigation cost share, disaster-aid sequencing, bonds/public financing, and explicit public subsidy terms.
public_balance_sheet_register.public_upside_recovery: Open blocker: no pass without mitigation conditions, risk-based fees, recoupment, public seniority, clawbacks, land-use/building-code conditions, or other recovery when public systems absorb downside.
public_balance_sheet_register.ordinary_claimant_protection: Protect lower-income homeowners, renters facing insurance pass-through, underinsured households, and mortgage-dependent buyers from hidden assessment and coverage-quality shocks.
public_balance_sheet_register.sunset_or_review: Monthly/quarterly while NFIP reauthorization/debt, FEMA reinsurance, GAO/FIO/NAIC data, Citizens, California FAIR Plan, and major post-disaster assessment surfaces update.

seniority_waterfall.claimant: Mortgage lenders and insured property claims
seniority_waterfall.notes: Insurability protects collateral and mortgage eligibility, but affordability and default channels remain open.
Premium/deductible shock can erode equity and liquidity.
Residual-plan losses can be spread through assessments/surcharges and recoupment; plan governance and exposure differ by state.
Costs pass through rents, prices, disaster aid, and adaptation spending.

validation_notes: rev0327 promotes this scoreboard to active: dynamic FAIR Plan/current insurance-market data and NAIC 2026 data-call currentness make residual insurance a live public-backstop case, not merely an illustration.
rev0344 binds formerly unused source S59 to `climate_residual_insurance_backstop` so active evidence lineage no longer leaves this source floating outside a case.
Rev0367 adds locator-bound residual-insurance/NFIP/FAIR Plan/Citizens/mortgage-stress edges; case remains not certified current.
